title: mongo: support zstd
description:
# Summary
- Support dissecting MongoDB packets with ZSTD compression.
- Add `tvb_uncompress_zstd` and `tvb_child_uncompress_zstd`.
- Replace ZSTD uncompression in `packet-kafka.c` with `tvb_child_uncompress_zstd`.

# Background & Motivation

Support for ZSTD followed the pattern of `MONGO_COMPRESSOR_SNAPPY`.

Tested MongoDB ZSTD compression with this packet capture: [mongo-multiple-zstd.pcapng](/uploads/a408824fb94031e2fcc3c21b58e56785/mongo-multiple-zstd.pcapng)

Tested with `fuzz-test.sh` using one MongoDB ZSTD compressed packet: [mongo-zstd.pcapng](/uploads/32bbb5719f22580be31650ba83f52c8d/mongo-zstd.pcapng)

```
cd build
../tools/fuzz-test.sh -a -d /tmp/fuzz -t 1800 mongo-zstd.pcapng
```

Tested Kafka ZSTD compression with the packet capture attached to https://bugs.wireshark.org/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=15988:

```
./build/run/wireshark \
        --display-filter "kafka && tcp.port == 9193" \
        -d tcp.port==9193,kafka \
        ./dump.kafka.produce.zstd.pcap
```

`tvb_uncompress_zstd` is a modified copy from `decompress_zstd` in `packet-kafka.c`. The modifications address two bugs:
- error on extra data https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9060/diffs?commit_id=281c6cba50f37415d4f6c981c456936a840c6af4
- do not create a composite buffer with empty data https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/9060/diffs?commit_id=ebbd6195adb5ed1eedd406aa120add6e2b5398a5

+@fixtures.mark_usefixtures('test_env')
+@fixtures.uses_fixtures
+class case_decompress_mongo(subprocesstest.SubprocessTestCase):
+    def test_decompress_zstd(self, cmd_tshark, capture_file):
+        proc = self.assertRun((cmd_tshark,
+                '-d', 'tcp.port==27017,mongo',
+                '-r', capture_file('mongo-zstd.pcapng'),
+                '-Tfields', '-emongo.element.name'
+        ))
+        # Check the element names of the decompressed body.
